title: Phaladeepika
author: Mantreswara
known_defects: Chapter 8, printed p.96: the section heading 'JUPITER' is run onto the end of Mercury's 12th-house paragraph. Corpus preserved as printed; card PD.08.Mercury.12 tightens its span and records why.

Chapter 8, verses 34-35: the Notes worked example and verse 35 appear to disagree about whether proximity to the Bhava-Madhya increases or decreases a placement's effect. Not yet extracted; needs adjudication.

Chapter 8, printed p.99-101: a transcribed horoscope chart and an editorial aside about Swami Ramakrishna Paramahamsa sit inside the Saturn section. Both are tier-3 apparatus and are excluded from rule extraction.
